free_tier.stated: No free tier. A 14-day free trial with no credit card and 'no commitment', which is deleted at the end unless extended. Plans: Small 1 TB at EUR 4.95/month including VAT, Basic 5 TB at EUR 15.95, Grow 10 TB at EUR 29.95, Big 25 TB at EUR 59.95

per_object_cap.notes: 10 GB is a fixed decimal limit that does not scale with plan size, requiring larger files to be divided into 10 GB parts.

retention.stated: Minimum term one month, cancellation monthly, no setup fee, and a 30-day money-back guarantee

egress.terms: 'Traffic Flatrate' on all four tiers, stated as a line of the feature comparison rather than a footnote

tooling: rclone webdav, the Nextcloud clients, and the admin panel for per-user quotas. 'Mount as network drive' is an advertised feature on every tier
chaining: Provides single-subscription capacity up to 25 TB. Full Nextcloud administrative access and per-user quota controls allow storage to be partitioned across separate credentials without purchasing multiple subscriptions.

limits.value: 10 GB per file on every tier, including 25 TB

identity_cost.detail: a Serverdiscounter account and a card. The trial is advertised as needing no card; the paid order does. No identity document stated

reliability_note: Stuttgart, Germany, 100% renewable power, UPS and backup power stated. 30-day money-back. The per-file cap is the friction and it is uniform across tiers, so it never improves with size

evidence.proved: 'NEXT Share Small ... EUR 4,95 /M, incl. VAT ... 1 TB', 'NEXT Share Basic EUR 15,95 ... 5 TB', 'NEXT Share Grow EUR 29,95 ... 10 TB', 'NEXT Big EUR 59,95 ... 25 TB', each with 'Users: Unlimited', 'Admin Access', 'Traffic Flatrate'
the detailed feature comparison gives 'Max. file size 10 GB 10 GB 10 GB 10 GB' against 1 TB / 5 TB / 10 TB / 25 TB, and 'Minimum term 1 Month' with 'Cancellation period Monthly'
FAQ: 'Is cloud storage per user? No, it's a quota per contract. You can create unlimited users and distribute the storage among all users'

price_per_tb_month: EUR 2.40/TB/month including VAT at 25 TB (EUR 59.95/month), rising to EUR 4.95/TB/month at 1 TB, read 2026-10-22
binding_note: The 25 TB plan provides unmetered network transfer within a single instance. The 10 GB per-file ceiling is the primary operational parameter, requiring files exceeding 10 GB to be partitioned prior to upload.
confidence_note: Prices and the 10 GB per-file cap are derived from the vendor comparison table verified on 2026-10-22. Confidence is documented rather than measured because active orders were not placed.
notes: Priced at EUR 2.40 per TB per month including VAT on the 25 TB tier. A 14-day trial is available without a credit card for evaluating WebDAV mounting and transfer performance prior to payment.

extras.trial: 14 days, no card, deleted unless extended
extras.contract: 1 month minimum, monthly cancellation, no setup fee
